Tutoring

How do I request a tutoring session?

Open the Book a Session page, complete the form and prepare your request. You then send the summary to Mr. Kamulegeya, who confirms the time and format with you.

Is a submitted request a confirmed booking?

No. A request is an enquiry. A session is only booked once Mr. Kamulegeya confirms it with you.

What kinds of tutoring can I ask about?

The enquiry covers one-on-one tutoring, group tutoring, examination preparation, online tutoring and mathematics consultation. Availability is confirmed on enquiry.

Does this website list fees or schedules?

No. Fees, availability and schedules are not published here. They are discussed when you enquire.

Ordering books

How do I order a book?

Use the Order Books page: choose the title and quantity, add your details, and say whether you prefer pickup or delivery.

Is an order request a confirmed order?

No. It is a request. Mr. Kamulegeya confirms availability and arrangements with you.

Can I pay online?

Not currently. Online payment is not set up on this website. Payment is arranged directly once your request is confirmed.

Forms and enquiries

Is my request sent automatically?

No. This website has no server that receives forms. When you finish a form you get a summary to send yourself, by WhatsApp or email when a verified contact is set up, or by copying the summary.

Schools

Can schools and institutions enquire?

Yes. Use the form on the Schools page to ask about mathematics department support, consultations, textbook supply, workshops or revision programmes. Details and availability are confirmed directly.

Resources

Where are the notes and practice material?

The resource library is being prepared. Items will be published only once they are verified.
